name: Pork Floss
source:
A young adult named Piper has recently moved to a new town, where she works alongside a cute blonde-haired baker called Elliot. 

This is a dating game about eating pastries made by a cute guy who's utterly obsessed with you. 

[Edited from [url=https://yueyuu.itch.io/pork-floss]itch.io[/url]]
